Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).
method linear_probe or linear_svm returns at most k cells (default 200, maximum 1000), ranked by score
descending then cell_id, plus total cells scored and min/median/max. Explicit cell_ids limit the scored
set. method vision_subagent sends a 0.5 m GSI aerial photo of each cell (Japan only) to a vision model
and returns per-cell label, confidence-based score and explanation; it requires explicit cell_ids
(maximum 20) and may be unconfigured. Use it to check embedding candidates visually.

content.text:
I didn't find any warehouses. The tools available here gave me no way to identify or rule one out, so the count is 0 confirmed, with no estimable range. The whole AOI (about 10 × 9 km) is unreviewed.

- **No labelled examples:** `get_examples` returned none for this area, so few-shot and concept-vector retrieval had nothing to start from.
- **No imagery:** `imagery_window` refused the Sentinel-2 request because this task has no imagery source. I couldn't check any building by eye.
- **No text search:** `zero_shot_text` retrieval is not configured.
- **Synthetic embeddings only:** The one index I built (`aef-10m-annual`, 160 m cells, 3,920 cells) is flagged as synthetic. It is a pooled fixture, not real AlphaEarth data.

A ranking from that index would have been guesswork, so I reported no candidate points. I recorded one claim with status `cannot_assess`, at the AOI centre (22.32, 91.83), and it is not grounded because no imagery was cited. I also logged the limits with `note_limitation`.

Even with imagery, 10 m data would struggle to tell warehouses from factories or markets at the 40 m minimum size.
